newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 16.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - July 16.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Canadian gold group Barrick Gold Corp was expected to launch a full takeover bid for Joe Gutnick's Great Central Mines Ltd within days, The Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Wednesday. Canada's Barrick Gold Corp on Tuesday declined to comment on reports that it was expected to launch a takeover bid for Great Central Mines. Normandy is also seen a potential takeover target by a big North American miner like Barrick or Homestake Gold or Placer Dome.

St George Bank Ltd said on Wednesday that it would securitise A$500 million of mortgages from its Great Australian Home Loan product as part of an ongoing strategy to diversify its funding base and manage its capital requirements.
Oil and gas explorer and producer Oil Search Ltd said on Tuesday it has encountered hydrocarbon shows in the Moran-3X well in Papua New Guinea.

Hills announced on Tuesday the M2 motorway in Sydney had average daily traffic for June, its first month of operation, of 39,801 vehicles, which The Australian said was 55 percent of prospectus forecasts. Hill said June contained 10 non-working days and school holidays and it was too early to make a judgement.
